method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Third rail is a lethal political taboo metaphor; not a third political party.
Original Kerry voted against the Protocol retained with note separating 1997 Byrd-Hagel resolution from a ratification vote.
HMOs rendered health maintenance organizations, preserving the original criticism of dropping seniors.
Claim of hundreds of thousands of Iraqi children dying due to sanctions retained as partisan candidate claim; not independently certified as a causal estimate.

revisions.source: James Buchanan had a lot of experience in government. Abraham Lincoln didn't. So what if I'm a little unseasoned? I have the instincts for the job.
revisions.zh: 詹姆斯·布坎南有很多政府工作经验。亚伯拉罕·林肯却没有。我略显生疏又怎样？我有胜任这份工作的直觉。

revisions.source: Dick Cheney is a principled conservative leader. The two of us will govern over a conservative, patriotic administration. Let's turn the page from the Clinton era.
revisions.zh: 迪克·切尼是一位有原则的保守派领导人。我们两人将领导一届保守、爱国的政府。让我们翻过克林顿时代这一页。

revisions.source: Dick Cheney is the best person for the job. He has served in all kinds of roles and performed admirably in every case.
revisions.zh: 迪克·切尼是最适合这份工作的人。他曾担任各种职务，每次都表现出色。

revisions.source: This is a good, conservative answer that will motivate your base. As always, make sure you find the right balance between getting your troops out and appealing to undecided voters.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错的保守派回答，会鼓舞你的基本盘。还是那句话，既要动员自己人投票，也要吸引未决定的选民，务必找到合适的平衡。

revisions.source: This is a good, mainstream answer. As always, make sure you balance the need to win moderates against the desires of your core supporters.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错的主流回答。还是那句话，要在争取温和派与满足核心支持者之间取得平衡。

revisions.source: You're certainly getting attention in the news for this stance, but it is not a mainstream position in your party. Perhaps this will establish you as an independent thinker...
revisions.zh: 你这一立场确实吸引了新闻关注，但在你党内并非主流。也许这会让你树立独立思考的形象……

revisions.source: It's important to stick to your principles, but your answer is not calibrated to win a majority of voters in November.
revisions.zh: 坚持原则很重要，但你的回答不是为了在11月赢得多数选民而设计的。

revisions.source: A lot of people say that Social Security is the third rail of American politics. You may have made some hard-core conservatives happy, but the vast majority of voters disagree with your stance.
revisions.zh: 许多人说，社会保障制度是美国政治中碰不得的“带电第三轨”。你也许让一些铁杆保守派高兴，但绝大多数选民并不赞同你的立场。

revisions.source: Foreign policy is not a huge issue in this election. Just avoid saying anything too hawkish or dovish so that you don't attract negative attention.
revisions.zh: 外交政策并不是这次选举的重大议题。只要避免说得过于鹰派或鸽派，以免招来负面关注就好。

revisions.source: This is a good, mainstream answer on foreign policy.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错的主流外交政策回答。

revisions.source: You are getting your core voters fired up, but it might be better not to mention Bill Clinton. He's a popular figure in America and you are trying to unseat his heir apparent.
revisions.zh: 你正在鼓舞核心选民，不过也许最好别提比尔·克林顿。他在美国颇受欢迎，而你正试图击败他公认的接班人。

revisions.source: For a Republican, there's nothing wrong with giving a pat phrase and moving to the next topic when it comes to Bill Clinton.
revisions.zh: 作为共和党人，谈到比尔·克林顿时，说一句套话就转到下个话题，并没有什么不妥。

revisions.source: The Elian issue is simple -- a small, politically active minority in Florida wants him to remain. There is also the issue of supporting or opposing Bill Clinton to consider.
revisions.zh: 埃利安问题很简单——佛罗里达州一个人数不多、政治上却很活跃的群体希望他留下。此外，还需要考虑支持还是反对比尔·克林顿。

revisions.source: Support and opposition to the Serbia air strikes is all over the place. Mainstream politicians support the action, while a combination of anti-war leftists and anti-Clinton Republicans oppose it.
revisions.zh: 对塞尔维亚空袭的支持和反对，并不按单一阵营划分。主流政界人士支持这次行动，反战左翼与反克林顿的共和党人则联合反对。

revisions.source: What?! You quickly clarify this statement, but it is too late. You have massively damaged your credibility with your base, and have probably lost a lot of votes to Buchanan or even Gore.
revisions.zh: 什么？！你很快澄清这番话，但已经太迟了。你严重损害了自己在基本盘中的信誉，很可能把许多选票送给了布坎南，甚至戈尔。

revisions.source: Americans generally have a decent opinion of Bill Clinton, and your answer might not fit the times that well. However, it will definitely motivate your conservative base.
revisions.zh: 美国人总体上对比尔·克林顿评价不错，你的回答可能不太符合当下的气氛。不过，这肯定会鼓舞你的保守派基本盘。

revisions.source: Americans generally have a decent opinion of Bill Clinton and Al Gore, and your answer might not fit the times that well. However, it will definitely motivate your conservative base.
revisions.zh: 美国人总体上对比尔·克林顿和阿尔·戈尔评价不错，你的回答可能不太符合当下的气氛。不过，这肯定会鼓舞你的保守派基本盘。

revisions.source: This is a theme that will establish you as a moderate, mainstream conservative. To run a national campaign against a popular Administration, this might be the right tone to strike.
revisions.zh: 这个主题会让你树立温和、主流保守派的形象。要在全国竞选中对抗一个受欢迎的政府，这也许是合适的基调。

revisions.source: Americans dislike partisan rancor, but is your speech the answer? What are the details? You also have to worry about alienating conservative supporters.
revisions.zh: 美国人不喜欢党派间的恶斗，但你的演说就是解决办法吗？具体细节呢？你还得担心疏远保守派支持者。

revisions.source: It is probably a bad idea to run against the record of Bill Clinton, given his popularity. Better to just ignore him and focus on other issues.
revisions.zh: 考虑到比尔·克林顿的受欢迎程度，拿他的执政记录开刀大概不是好主意。最好干脆不谈他，关注其他问题。

revisions.source: Ignoring Clinton is a good idea, and the rest of this strategy establishes your conservative bona fides. It could be interesting.
revisions.zh: 不谈克林顿是个好主意，这套策略的其他部分也证明了你确实是保守派。可能会有点意思。

revisions.source: It is risky to run an overtly negative campaign after the recent Clinton-Gingrich battles. It might be better to focus on your own plans for government.
revisions.zh: 最近刚经历克林顿与金里奇的争斗，公开开展负面竞选是有风险的。也许更应该关注你自己的执政计划。

revisions.source: This is a good strategy, if the goal is moving past the Clinton years and presenting yourself as an acceptable mainstream leader.
revisions.zh: 如果目标是告别克林顿时代，把自己塑造成一位大家能接受的主流领导人，这就是个好策略。

revisions.source: Alright. Way to get that crowd fired up.
revisions.zh: 不错，这可把人群的热情点燃了。

revisions.source: Hopefully you can pull Florida out and win the election. Good luck!
revisions.zh: 但愿你能拿下佛罗里达州，赢得大选。祝你好运！

revisions.source: Hopefully you can pull Ohio and Pennsylvania out and win the election. Good luck!
revisions.zh: 但愿你能拿下俄亥俄州和宾夕法尼亚州，赢得大选。祝你好运！

revisions.source: Hopefully you can pull these states out and win the election. Good luck!
revisions.zh: 但愿你能拿下这些州，赢得大选。祝你好运！

revisions.source: This is widely seen as a poor response to the news that broke. Hopefully you can still win the election.
revisions.zh: 人们普遍认为，你对刚曝光的消息回应不佳。但愿你仍能赢得大选。

revisions.source: Your response struck some as too passive and apologetic. Definitely not in character for a potential world leader.
revisions.zh: 有些人觉得，你的回应太被动，太低声下气，完全不像一位潜在世界领袖应有的表现。

revisions.source: This is probably the best you could do under the circumstances. Good luck!
revisions.zh: 在这种情况下，你大概也只能应对到这个程度了。祝你好运！

revisions.source: Americans want to hear you address this personally, and not watch as you hide behind a spokeswoman.
revisions.zh: 美国人想听你亲自回应，而不是看你躲在一位女发言人身后。

revisions.source: Many people are questioning your credibility and fitness based on this issue. There are too many sources and witnesses for you to deny these things completely.
revisions.zh: 许多人因为这件事，质疑你的可信度和任职资格。消息来源和证人太多，你不能把这些事情全盘否认。

revisions.source: This is probably the best response you can give, given some of these things that happened when you were young and immature.
revisions.zh: 考虑到年轻不成熟时发生的一些事，这大概是你能给出的最佳回应。

revisions.source: It might be better to admit that something happened and address it.
revisions.zh: 也许最好承认确实发生过什么，并正面回应。

revisions.source: This is a good, solid response to the question.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错、扎实的回答。

revisions.source: Interesting answer, though a few people are mumbling about you comparing yourself to Lincoln.
revisions.zh: 回答有点意思，不过有些人正在嘀咕，你竟然把自己比作林肯。

revisions.source: This is a good, liberal answer that will motivate your base. As always, make sure you find the right balance between getting your troops out and appealing to undecided voters.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错的自由派回答，会鼓舞你的基本盘。还是那句话，既要动员自己人投票，也要吸引未决定的选民，务必找到合适的平衡。

revisions.source: What?! You quickly clarify this statement, but it is too late. You have massively damaged your credibility with your base, and have probably lost a lot of votes to Nader or even Bush.
revisions.zh: 什么？！你很快澄清这番话，但已经太迟了。你严重损害了自己在基本盘中的信誉，很可能把许多选票送给了纳德，甚至布什。

revisions.source: It would probably be better not to repudiate Clinton so harshly. Not only is he broadly popular, but you also served with him for eight years.
revisions.zh: 大概最好别那么严厉地否定克林顿。他不仅广受欢迎，你还与他共事了八年。

revisions.source: It is a net positive that you are embracing Clinton's legacy. Just keep in mind that there's a trade-off -- some left-wing voters believe that Clinton is too moderate.
revisions.zh: 认同克林顿留下的政绩，总体上对你有利。不过要记住，这也有代价——有些左翼选民认为克林顿太温和。

revisions.source: It does not look good for Al Gore, noted environmentalist, to come out against the Kyoto Protocol.
revisions.zh: 阿尔·戈尔这位知名环保人士，出来反对《京都议定书》，可不好看。

revisions.source: This is a good hedge. Even John Kerry voted against the Protocol.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错的保留说法。连约翰·克里都投票反对过议定书。

revisions.source: Immigration is not a big issue in this election. There's no reason to make an unforced error like this.
revisions.zh: 移民并不是这次选举的重要议题。没理由像这样自己犯错。

revisions.source: Interesting ideas, but immigration is not a big issue in this election. But no harm, no foul.
revisions.zh: 想法有点意思，但移民并不是这次选举的重要议题。不过，既然没造成什么损失，也就无妨。

revisions.source: Immigration is not a big issue in this election. Better to just focus on your core platform.
revisions.zh: 移民并不是这次选举的重要议题。最好专注于你的核心纲领。

revisions.source: What?! The purpose of your candidacy is to provide a solid, left-wing alternative to the two main parties. People are wondering what you meant by taking this stance.
revisions.zh: 什么？！你参选的目的，是在两大党之外提供一个坚定的左翼选择。人们正在问，你采取这个立场到底是什么意思。

revisions.source: This is a good, left-wing answer that will motivate your base.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错的左翼回答，会鼓舞你的基本盘。

revisions.source: This is a good answer for a Green Party candidate.
revisions.zh: 对于绿党候选人而言，这是个好回答。

revisions.source: The best course for a Green Party candidate is to oppose foreign intervention under almost all circumstances.
revisions.zh: 对于绿党候选人而言，最好的做法是在几乎所有情况下都反对对外干预。

revisions.source: It's probably best to ignore Bill Clinton, and focus your statements on Bush, Gore, and the two-party system in general.
revisions.zh: 大概最好别谈比尔·克林顿，而是把发言重点放在布什、戈尔和整个两党制上。

revisions.source: This stance helps you in a couple of coal states, but definitely raises eyebrows among the mainstream left.
revisions.zh: 这个立场能在几个产煤州帮到你，但肯定会让主流左翼侧目。

revisions.source: Today you have announced the selection of John Danforth as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
revisions.zh: 今天，你宣布选择约翰·丹福思作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

revisions.source: Do you support the air strikes and sanctions that have been levied against Iraq, with the goal of weakening Saddam Hussein?
revisions.zh: 你支持为了削弱萨达姆·侯赛因，而对伊拉克实施的空袭与制裁吗？

revisions.source: What is your opinion on the performance and conduct of our current President, Bill Clinton?
revisions.zh: 你如何评价现任总统比尔·克林顿的执政表现和行为？

revisions.source: Should low-income parents be able to use federal vouchers to send their children to private schools?
revisions.zh: 是否应允许低收入家长使用联邦教育券，让孩子上私立学校？

revisions.source: Do you have any plans to help America's seniors better pay for vital prescription drugs?
revisions.zh: 你打算帮助美国老年人，更好地负担必需的处方药吗？

revisions.source: I don't think we need to make huge changes to a system that works for the majority of the people it is supposed to help.
revisions.zh: 对这个能帮助多数目标人群的制度，我认为不需要大幅改革。

revisions.source: I believe we should address this problem directly -- by adding a prescription drug benefit to Medicare.
revisions.zh: 我认为，我们应当直接处理这个问题——在老年医疗保险中加入处方药福利。

revisions.source: We need more funding for Medicare. We need to hold providers accountable when they fall short, by curbing excess profits for pharmaceuticals and targeting HMOs that drop seniors.
revisions.zh: 我们需要增加老年医疗保险的经费。服务不到位时，应追究提供方的责任，遏制药品的过高利润，并整治抛弃老年参保人的健康维护组织。

revisions.source: We should incorporate Medicare into a larger, universal single-payer health insurance program. Many proposals I hear about are overly cautious and lacking in ambition.
revisions.zh: 我们应当把老年医疗保险纳入更广泛、覆盖全民的单一支付方医疗保险制度。我听到的许多提议都过于谨慎，缺乏雄心。

revisions.source: I believe we haven't gone far enough on this issue. Saddam Hussein is a destabilizing leader, and he must be removed for the Middle East to truly prosper.
revisions.zh: 我认为，我们在这个问题上做得还不够。萨达姆·侯赛因破坏稳定，只有让他下台，中东才能真正繁荣。

revisions.source: We are following the right course in Iraq. We must enforce our agreement to prevent Saddam from acquiring weapons of mass destruction. Saddam is allowing the sanctions to harm his people for his own selfish purposes.
revisions.zh: 我们对伊拉克采取的路线是正确的。我们必须执行防止萨达姆取得大规模杀伤性武器的协议。萨达姆为了自己的私利，任由制裁伤害本国人民。

revisions.source: The United States is much too entangled in the Middle East. We should pull back from the region and end sanctions in Iraq. I might remind people that these sanctions have killed hundreds of thousands of Iraqi children.
revisions.zh: 美国过度卷入中东事务。我们应当从该地区抽身，并结束对伊拉克的制裁。我可能会提醒人们，这些制裁已经害死了数十万伊拉克儿童。

revisions.source: I see how this is appealing to some conservatives, but it still represents the interference of the federal government in education.
revisions.zh: 我明白，这对一些保守派很有吸引力，但它仍然意味着联邦政府干预教育。

revisions.source: I strongly support this idea and will work to implement it as President. All parents deserve to choose where their child will attend school.
revisions.zh: 我大力支持这个想法，担任总统后会推动实施。所有家长都应能选择孩子去哪所学校。

revisions.source: This plan will take money out of the public schools and will not fix the underlying problem of poor education in the United States.
revisions.zh: 这个计划会抽走公立学校的经费，却无法解决美国教育不佳的根本问题。

revisions.source: My campaign isn't about Bill Clinton. I prefer to focus on the future, and on the issues that will strengthen our country and economy.
revisions.zh: 我的竞选不是围绕比尔·克林顿展开的。我愿意关注未来，以及能让国家和经济更加强大的问题。

revisions.source: Bill Clinton's partisan attacks have degraded the political culture of our country. I will be a uniter, not a divider, when I am in the White House.
revisions.zh: 比尔·克林顿的党派攻击败坏了我国的政治文化。入主白宫后，我会团结人民，而不是制造分裂。

revisions.source: Bill Clinton pushed through a tax increase, new gun control laws, a lot of environmental regulations, and has been subject to numerous fundraising and corruption allegations. Not to mention his infamous personal conduct in the White House.
revisions.zh: 比尔·克林顿推动了加税、新的枪支管制法和一大批环保法规，还面对大量关于筹款与腐败的指控。更不用说，他在白宫臭名昭著的个人行为。

revisions.source: We can all learn a lot from Bill Clinton's ability to compromise with Congress and pursue a moderate political agenda. I will do the same as President.
revisions.zh: 我们都能从比尔·克林顿与国会妥协、推行温和政治议程的能力中学到很多。作为总统，我也会这么做。

revisions.source: John Danforth is a strong, religious man with a good heart. He is a wonderful example of a leader that conservatives can produce.
revisions.zh: 约翰·丹福思坚定、虔诚而善良。他是保守派所能培养出的领导人的一个杰出典范。

revisions.source: John Danforth has served his home state of Missouri well. I think he has a record that all Americans can get behind.
revisions.zh: 约翰·丹福思出色地服务了家乡密苏里州。我认为，他的政绩能得到所有美国人的支持。

revisions.source: The consensus view is that the U.S. should continue to strike foreign terrorist networks. Voters don't want to see a U.S. pullback, nor do they wish to see a large-scale conflict or ground invasion.
revisions.zh: 普遍看法是，美国应继续打击境外恐怖网络。选民既不希望美国退缩，也不希望出现大规模冲突或地面入侵。

revisions.source: This is a good idea for dealing with any issues or questions relating to Bill Clinton.
revisions.zh: 这是应对任何与比尔·克林顿有关的问题或质疑的好办法。

revisions.source: A lot of moderates blame Republicans as much as or more than Bill Clinton for the partisanship of the 1990s.
revisions.zh: 许多温和派认为，共和党对20世纪90年代的党派对立，应承担与比尔·克林顿同样多、甚至更多的责任。
